name: session-journal
description: Record Claude Code and Codex sessions to an Obsidian vault (or a subfolder of an existing one): an append-only raw event log plus one regenerated summary note per session — no verbatim transcript, no auto-generated wiki. Every note is tagged #ai-generated to stay distinct from hand-authored notes. Portable name-based vault resolution (with an explicit-pin guard against duplicate same-named vaults) for multi-machine setups synced via Obsidian Sync.
